"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/longest-happy-prefix/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1392. Longest Happy Prefix

A string is called a happy prefix if it is a non-empty prefix which is also a suffix (excluding itself).

Given a string s, return the longest happy prefix of s. Return an empty string "" if no such prefix exists.

Example 1:

Input: s = "level"
Output: "l"
Explanation: s contains 4 prefix excluding itself ("l", "le", "lev", "leve"), and suffix ("l", "el", "vel", "evel"). The largest prefix which is also suffix is given by "l".

Example 2:

Input: s = "ababab"
Output: "abab"
Explanation: "abab" is the largest prefix which is also suffix. They can overlap in the original string.

Constraints:

    1 <= s.length <= 10^5
    s contains only lowercase English letters.
"""


class Solution:
    def longestPrefix(self, s: str) -> str:
        n = len(s)
        lps = [0] * n  # longest prefix suffix array
        length = 0  # length of the previous longest prefix suffix

        # the loop calculates lps[i] for i from 1 to n-1
        i = 1
        while i < n:
            if s[i] == s[length]:
                length += 1
                lps[i] = length
                i += 1
            else:
                if length != 0:
                    length = lps[length - 1]
                else:
                    lps[i] = 0
                    i += 1

        return s[: lps[-1]]


sol = Solution()

print(sol.longestPrefix("level"))  # "l"

assert sol.longestPrefix("level") == "l"
assert sol.longestPrefix("ababab") == "abab"

assert sol.longestPrefix("a") == ""
assert sol.longestPrefix("aa") == "a"
assert sol.longestPrefix("abcabc") == "abc"
assert sol.longestPrefix("abcdabc") == "abc"
assert sol.longestPrefix("zzzzzzzzzz") == "zzzzzzzzz"
assert (
    sol.longestPrefix("abcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabc") == "abcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabc"
)
assert sol.longestPrefix("abcabcxabcabc") == "abcabc"
assert (
    sol.longestPrefix("xyzxyzxyzxyzxyzxyzxyzxyzxyzxyz") == "xyzxyzxyzxyzxyzxyzxyzxyzxyz"
)
